calibration_source.name: Kelvin task-quality review, author-side verification (2026-10-17)
calibration_source.scope: HarmonyGames tasks checked against the base universe. Calibration for the expected_values ledger (Eval 2 section 2.4); regression tests in tools/tests/test_hg_oe_values.py. Not counted in the historical counts above.

calibration_cases.expected_text: claiming a quest logs `quest_completion` with quest_id and reward_content
calibration_cases.record_evidence: AnalyticsManager.cs:849-856 (harmonygames-Games/match3d): OnQuestCompletion logs const string QuestCompletionEvent = "quest_completed"; the QuestCompletion method that declares "quest_completion" (:606-618) has no caller.
calibration_cases.expected_result: INACCURATE with source_value quest_completed: WRONG_EXPECTED_DATA, Accuracy FAIL (2). Recording it VERIFIED against the live call is rejected.
calibration_cases.note: The task has no saved OE file; the wrong key was in its answer key. The fixture step restates that claim as an Expected line. The OE review itself never reads the rubric.

calibration_cases.expected_text: The agent finds that none of the 33 flagged pull requests shows a later commit or merged follow-up PR that addresses the specific finding named in its Critical comment, every one is still correctly disclosed as open, not remediated.
calibration_cases.record_evidence: Base GitHub data: 24 of the 99 Critical comments end with a CodeRabbit '✅ Addressed in commit X' note (GameOfDominoes #1912 rc_1: 77cf03f 'Wait on all assets to download.'), and commit b254afcc fixes Combo-Fighters #18.
calibration_cases.expected_result: INACCURATE with a counterexample quote: the absence claim is refuted, WRONG_EXPECTED_DATA, Accuracy FAIL (2). VERIFIED needs a scope-bound ABSENCE evidence_check; a DIRECT quote of the injected register policy is rejected.
calibration_cases.note: OE 15 is written without an Expected: label; the 'The agent finds' sentence is its Expected line.
